hero.title: Our Programs
hero.subtitle: EmpowerKids–South Sudan works through four core programme areas: Education, Agriculture, Youth Empowerment, and Advocacy & Civic Engagement.

cards.title: Education Support
cards.description: School partnerships, teacher capacity building, and scholarship pathways to universities abroad.

cards.title: Empower Farmers South Sudan
cards.description: Climate‑smart conservation agriculture using the Foundations for Farming model.

cards.title: Youth Empowerment
cards.description: Entrepreneurship, leadership, and platforms where young voices reach a national audience.

cards.title: Advocacy & Civic Engagement
cards.description: Strengthening community voice, governance awareness, and local participation.

featured.heading: Featured Programme
featured.title: Empower Farmers South Sudan 🌱
featured.description: Our 50×100 m demonstration farm in Gumbo‑Sherikat, Juba 2, uses Foundations for Farming conservation agriculture to promote food security. With a 21‑person field team, we have trained 129 farmers to date, harvesting 472.44 kg of maize from just 0.132 ha.

cta.heading: Support Our Programs
cta.text: Your contribution helps us scale education, agriculture, youth empowerment, and civic engagement across South Sudan.
